title: Minus one Homogeneous Euler Flows are Geodesible
summary: In this paper, we study $(-1)$-homogeneous steady solutions to the Euler equations on $\mathbb{R}^n \setminus \{0\}$. In low dimensions $n=2,3$, such flows are known to be essentially trivial. In contrast, we show that in higher dimensions $n \ge 4$, every $(-1)$-homogeneous Euler flow is a geodesible vector field with constant Bernoulli function. Moreover, any $(-1)$-homogeneous geodesible field is induced by a geodesible field on the sphere $\mathbb{S}^{n-1}$.
